title: Joe Howard teaches him to read and to tune a drum
summary: Joe Howard taught him music from methods and rubber pads, and tuning bass drum to the A string and snare to trumpet.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
